# Skills Governance Technology Notes

Skills governance is the practice of defining, validating, and overseeing the skills that
an organization relies on, so that competency claims map to verifiable evidence rather
than to self-reported labels.

A skills taxonomy is the shared vocabulary that links roles to competencies, and it is the
foundation that downstream inference, evaluation, and reporting all depend upon.

AI-based skill inference should be evaluated with benchmarks, structured human review, and
deployment telemetry before its outputs are trusted in promotion or hiring decisions.

Interoperability standards and verifiable credentials are recurring themes, because skills
data loses value when it cannot move across the platforms that produce and consume it.
